title: Baton
description: A manifest-driven command-line tool for handing development projects between Linux machines. Departure reviews Git, stash and optional Beads state without sending changes. A separate arrival preview shows planned work before cloning or fast-forwarding repositories, restoring configured links, pulling Beads data, and copying missing local files over SSH. It does not push, rebase or resolve divergent histories. In active development; source is currently private.
